prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production clean background plate for the attached APPROVED L5R game scene. Preserve EXACT camera, mat outline, perspective, sunset, mountain shapes, sun position, warm field, navy cloth grain, aged subtle blood stains, antique gold Japanese floral/wave border and the crossed swords plus FIVE elemental emblems in the mat center. Do not zoom out or recompose. Preserve all empty background pixels faithfully.
REMOVE every single playing card from the entire image: both upright champion groups including attachment cards, the two outer green deck stacks, all eight green focus cards, all five hand cards, and both face-up lower-corner stacks. REMOVE all UI text: Menu, Strike, the 4 and 3, and red UI slash. Reconstruct the hidden cloth or scenery naturally behind every removed element. No card-shaped shadows, no rectangles, no new props, no glyphs, no extra decoration or labels. The result is ONLY the empty approved navy campaign mat with its exact fine gold border and existing central crossed-swords/five-ring design, set in the SAME beautiful sunset field. Keep foreground entirely cloth; no reeds intruding over the near edge. Full 16:9 composition, highest-detail faithful materials. This plate will have real interactive game cards and text placed on top; never bake any cards or UI into it.
source_reuse: Approved image cleaned into a dedicated plate preserving scene, mat, filigree and composition. Cards, names, values, focus backs and controls are live original game content, not baked into the plate.
rendering: Layered animated matte and projected flat cards, with separate upright interactive CardTile controls. Motion does not move engine cards.
